_meta.note: Captured off the wire: pi-acp 0.0.34 over pi 1.3.0 (the lane pin) with Kiro Crew's gate extension loaded through the gate launcher (PI_ACP_PI_COMMAND) and the per-session MCP handoff file named in KIROCREW_PI_MCP_HANDOFF and sealed with the per-spawn key in KIROCREW_PI_MCP_KEY, written by Crew's own PiLaunch (only the OS sandbox stood in for) from one stdio element (server name probe-server, a real stdio MCP server with one tool, echo). The session/new array carried the same element; pi-acp drops it. The model is a scripted OpenAI-compatible endpoint on the loopback interface named in pi's own models.json, told to call mcp__probe_server__echo. The frames: the initialize and session/new responses, the tool_call, the session/request_permission the adapter forwarded from the extension's confirm dialog (its message is the gate envelope naming mcp__probe_server__echo), then, after the client answered yes, the updates through completed carrying the server's own result (ECHO:ping) and the session/prompt result. The server's own log recorded initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, tools/call. Reductions: 1 configOptions select(s) cut to the one option naming its currentValue: the full list is the provider and model catalog the recording host could reach; 3 available_commands_update/session_info_update frame(s) dropped: they carry the recording host's own command inventory and run id; the session id is replaced with the synthetic pi-session-1; the confirm dialogs' uuids are replaced with synthetic pi-ui-perm-N ids. The working directory was a scratch project.
